destinationParity.legacyRedirects: apps/web/lib/nav/legacy-redirects.ts unchanged against HEAD; existing org-scoped redirect construction retained.

sourcePreserved.finding: DashboardHomeView remains mounted. Snapshot/home reads and board mutations use /api/dashboards. Dashboard, dashboard libraries and its API have no working-tree diff against HEAD. Real quick task and scouting actions remain /api/todos and ScoutingClient.
Hub embeds the existing LogisticsClient; /api/logistics, role-filtered checklist, management panels, offline snapshots and standalone /logistics remain. TeamOpsNav is suppressed when embedded.

Hub embeds the same IntelClient scouting variant as the preserved direct route. Intel CSS is imported by the client. Real roster, team lookup, source filtering, notes, comparison and pick-list service paths remain.

Existing CAD/code components are unchanged against HEAD and remain embedded in Build. Onshape editing, Fusion desktop pairing, GitHub connection, repository/file selection and job API paths remain. This does not prove live provider credentials, a paired desktop or actual editor execution.

Business retains actual finance, sponsor, grant and order clients and APIs. Inventory mutations retain membership checks, RLS and unified parts ledger. Inventory API and receive-to-inventory service are unchanged against HEAD. Prior bounded local purchase/receive/repair and ledger journey evidence is recorded separately and predates this redesign audit.

Hub filtering, owner/admin settings gates, sponsor-funding filtering, saved personal island preferences and API-level membership/RLS code remain. Selected-team context findings below prevent claiming full permission acceptance from preservation alone.

openFindings.issue: The shared shell soft-navigates same-route team-switch links and updates its topbar org. ProductHubShell initializes orgId only on the hub effect and its URL follower only updates tab. The newly embedded Teams and Logistics clients likewise read org on mount. A same-route org switch may retain the previous team's data or mutation identity while the address and topbar show the new team.
openFindings.requiredProof: With one normally authenticated member belonging to two synthetic teams, switch team without changing hub pathname; verify hub context, data, permission reads and subsequent reversible mutations all use the new org. Repeat Back/Forward.
openFindings.recommendation: Follow org changes alongside tabs and remount or reset embedded clients by selected org. Abort/ignore stale loads and invalidate user/org caches. Preserve actual service authorization; do not inject sessions or bypass the UI.

openFindings.issue: useClientAccessProfile uses requestMe(), which fetches /api/me without orgId. The API uses the first membership when orgId is absent. ProductHubShell and Business can therefore use a different team's allowlist or sponsor-funding rules on a selected-team URL. This is a retained baseline defect rather than proof of a redesign-created server authorization bypass.
openFindings.recommendation: Scope permission reads and shared cache keys to requesting user and selected org, revalidate on team change, and verify allowlisted members on two teams with different permissions.

openFindings.issue: The visible shell Back action pushes a fixed parent href. Its helper receives pathname and org only, so preceding filters, tab query and scroll position are not preserved. Existing shared navigation helpers perform soft routing and URL-change notifications, but do not maintain a return-state/scroll history.
openFindings.recommendation: Use validated in-app navigation history with a safe direct-link fallback and restore relevant filters/scroll, then verify phone detail-to-list journeys.

openFindings.issue: Embedded Teams loading/error branches still use IntelShell, which always renders a main landmark and Research title. Under ProductHubShell this creates nested main landmarks and inconsistent Teams/Research state labels.
openFindings.recommendation: Pass embedded and scouting-variant context through IntelShell; use a section for embedded states and preserve standalone Research behavior.

openFindings.issue: Adding Team Logistics leaves separate search destinations for /team?tab=logistics and /logistics, plus corresponding hub/direct Duties and Visit invites aliases. Catalog deduplication compares literal hrefs rather than canonical destinations.
openFindings.recommendation: Preserve direct URLs while showing one canonical Team destination in search, merging existing travel/hotel/duty/RSVP synonyms.
